topic: Reviewing Germany traffic data and presentation
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on reviewing analytics for a German facility. Initial concerns were raised regarding low data levels and potential antenna issues, noting that the site was offline at one point.

[p1] shared a staging link containing traffic data for Germany (Sept 26th to Oct 24th), showing total uniques of 11 million.

Participants confirmed that 11 million unique users over a month is realistic, accounting for both business travelers and tourists. The session concluded with the review and approval of a presentation draft related to this data.
decisions: The Germany traffic data (Sept 26th - Oct 24th) was reviewed and deemed acceptable.
Slide 7 in the German presentation should be deleted.
